Top 10 app ideas checked against real evidence (researched 2 Nov 2026)

On this page

  1. Ranking
  2. The pattern
  3. Evidence per idea
  4. What to do with this

Follow-up to 100_user_problems.md. Five research agents checked the 10 shortlisted ideas on the web: official numbers, competitor apps on the Play Store (India listings, read 2 Nov 2026), their recurring complaints, and any sign people pay.

Big limit: Reddit was blocked for every agent (search and fetch), so real user voices are thin; they come from Blind, news stories, Play Store reviews and studies instead. "unverified" = seen only in a search summary or a third-party page.

Ranking

Scores 1–5. Pain = how strong and widespread; Pay = evidence people pay; Gap = room left by existing apps.

The pattern

  • Where the pain is biggest, a giant gives the fix away free: scams (Truecaller, Google), train waitlists (IRCTC, ixigo/ConfirmTkt), UPI mandates (NPCI).
  • Where people already pay, the field is crowded: calorie apps (HealthifyMe, Cal AI), screen-time apps (Opal, one sec, ScreenZen, BrainPal).
  • Ideas no one is doing are often unpaid for a reason: document vault, maid attendance, work-wins.
  • Implication: win on a narrow gap the leader leaves, or bundle so someone with money pays.

Evidence per idea

#13 Scam Check for parents

  • Losses Rs 22,845.73 crore in 2024 (up from Rs 7,465 crore in 2023), 36.37 lakh incidents on NCRP — government figures via Scroll, 2025. Rs 19,813 crore in 2025 — I4C via IANS, Jan 2026.
  • Digital-arrest incidents 39,925 (2022) → 123,672 (2024) — IndiaSpend on NCRP data.
  • User voice: a Blind poster whose parents sent about Rs 50 lakh to a fake "your son is in custody" caller (Dec 2023).
  • Competition: Truecaller Scam Checker (launched end of Sep 2026) — free, checks pasted text, links and numbers; no screenshots yet ("Text only for now"). Google on-device scam detection (Pixel 9+ only in India). Sanchar Saathi/Chakshu lets you report, not check. ScamMukt ~Rs 50/month (traction unverified).
  • Pay: Truecaller Premium Rs 79/month; ~4M payers out of ~350M Indian users.
  • Blockers: Play Store lets only default SMS/phone apps read SMS, so no auto-scan; WhatsApp gives no access — parent must forward or screenshot; liability if a scam is marked "SAFE"; DPDP Act.
  • Gap left: screenshots, Indian languages, an alert to the child, an elder-first UI.

#16 Daily "I'm okay" check-in

  • 5.7% of people 60+ live alone (9.0% of women) — LASI Wave 1 (2017–18). Loneliness about 37% among them.
  • "Are You Dead?" (Demumu) became the #1 paid iPhone app in China in Jan 2026 (~8 yuan).
  • Competition: Snug Safety (iOS ~4.9; complaints of false alarms), HaalChaal, KinStatus, CheckinBee ($14/month); Emoha and Samarth sell 24/7 emergency response.
  • Pay: Samarth ~Rs 9,999/month care plans; Privilege plan Rs 4,800/year — families pay for human help.
  • Blockers: phone makers' battery savers kill reminders (false alarms); elders drop the daily habit; liability if an alert fails.

#24 Scroll Wrapped / reels counter

  • Indian short-video use ~38–45 min/day (Redseer 2022, Bain 2022).
  • Competition (Play India): BrainPal (ex "BrainRot: Reels Counter") 4.5★, 79K reviews, 10L+ installs — counts reels, limits, friend battles; ScreenZen 4.6★ 10L+; one sec 4.5★ 10L+.
  • Complaints: locks too easy to bypass, paywalled features, stops working after updates, privacy unease.
  • Pay: Opal revenue estimated ~$4.8M (2024, third-party estimate).
  • Blockers: Android Accessibility policy (prominent disclosure + Play declaration); iOS cannot count reels; counters break when Instagram/YouTube change their UI.
  • Gap left: a strict lock you can't cheat, a better shareable "Wrapped".

#43 Indian-food calorie app

  • HealthifyMe's own photo accuracy ~60–70% (TechCrunch 2023) to ~80% (OpenAI case study, unverified); struggles with multi-item plates — the thali case.
  • Competition (Play India): HealthifyMe 4.4★ 1Cr+ (complaints: wrong counts, slow fixes, refunds); Cal AI 4.4★ 10L+ (inaccurate logging, paywall after signup); MyFitnessPal 4.5★ 10Cr+.
  • Pay: Cal AI ~$35M run rate (May 2025, founder-reported); reportedly acquired by MyFitnessPal in 2026 (unverified).
  • Blockers: photos can't see oil/ghee/portions; India pays less per user.
  • Gap left: thali and portion accuracy.

#2 Subscription / UPI AutoPay tracker

  • Complaints of Rs 1–2 trials becoming Rs 149–699 auto-debits (Kuku FM, Stage) — Outlook Money, May 2025; Seekho charging after cancel — The Ken, May 2025; mandates on a mother's phone — Asianet, Jul 2026.
  • RBI E-mandate Framework 2026 (21 Apr 2026): 24-hour pre-debit notice; opt out of one debit or the mandate.
  • Competition: NPCI UPI Help can view/pause/revoke all mandates from any UPI app (rolling out); GPay/PhonePe/Paytm show their own mandates; Rocket Money doesn't work in India.
  • Blockers: SMS reading allowed for "SMS-based money management" with Google review; iOS no SMS; a third-party app can't revoke a mandate (needs UPI PIN).

#91 Train waitlist predictor

  • Waitlisted passengers who couldn't travel: 2.72 crore (FY23) → 3.39 crore (FY26) (RTI via NDTV/Curly Tales).
  • Competition: ConfirmTkt 4.9★ 10Cr+, ixigo Trains 4.8★ 10Cr+, RailYatri, IRCTC (CRIS prediction since 2018).
  • Pay: people pay for refund guarantees (ixigo 2X–3X), not predictions.
  • Blockers: only licensed agents sell tickets; IRCTC terms bar automated access; no historical data.

#44 Lab report explainer

  • ~35–38% of 110 inpatients couldn't understand their results (SRM study).
  • Competition: small paid apps (ReportSaathi 10K+, others ≤1L installs, Rs 29–4,300); labs building it in-house (Healthians, PharmEasy); free ChatGPT/Gemini. ChatGPT Health is US-only.
  • Blockers: Telemedicine Guidelines 2020 (AI can't counsel/prescribe); CDSCO software-as-medical-device rules (unverified); Play health declaration; DPDP.

#63 Document vault

  • ~56% of registered vehicles uninsured (Parliamentary committee 2024–25 via ETV Bharat); PUC compliance <30% in several states (CARS24, vendor data); Rs 10,000 PUC fine in Delhi.
  • Competition: DigiLocker (~3.9★, govt docs only, no reminders); Park+ (10M+) already sends vehicle insurance/PUC/challan alerts; warranty trackers with almost no reviews.
  • Pay: none found.

#53 Maid attendance & salary

  • One reported Bengaluru dispute (News Karnataka, Feb 2025); developer copy describes month-end arguments.
  • Competition: MyGate 4.7★ 50L+ (attendance + pay, no leave/advance; ad complaints); several free niche apps at 50–1K installs.
  • Pay: none found.

#37 Work-wins journal

  • Julia Evans's brag-document post (2019) names the pain.
  • Pay: BragJournal (this exact product) shows $12 MRR, 2 subscribers, $174 all-time (TrustMRR).
  • Free templates and ChatGPT do the job; enterprise tools (Lattice, Confirm) own the paid side.

What to do with this

  1. Bundle the parents' ideas (#13 + #16 + medicine reminders) into one "parents' safety" app the child pays for. Separately each scores 9–10 with weak payment; together it matches what families already buy (elder-care plans), and it targets the gap Truecaller leaves: screenshots, Indian languages, child alerts.
  2. Or take a proven-money category with a narrow gap: a reels blocker you can't cheat (#24) or thali accuracy (#43). Expect strong competition.
  3. Before building, get the missing user voices: read Reddit (r/india, r/bangalore, r/IndianFitness) by hand and talk to 10 people in the target group.
